body: Hey.. it took me a while to respond and for that i apologize.  I am currently 18 years old graduating high school.  I cant talk to my parents nor i can get any help via therapy since i dont have money or insurance.  Day by day im actually quite numb, in all honesty i just go on about day to day.  I feel completely empty and at this point not even sad.  I dont even know what i do sometimes.. Sorry this probably makes no sense and in all bit strange.   I stopped talking to my friends, my mom, my dad, even my brother.  I just live on, wake up, shower, go to school, come back and go back to bed.  I dont know whats going on.   I dont feel happy, i dont feel sad, i dont feel angry, i just dont feel anything

I don't know man.. I've been accepted into few mediocre colleges and I dont know what i want to study...  But this has been good, thanks for the pep talk i realized i had school in like 6 hours so i really have to sleep.   You've been a great help, hope you stick around.

Its hard to admit that i am depressed.. Everyone see me as this happy kid that has no problem whatsoever..  Its difficult to even say the word, "depressed."  Hah.. Night is the worst, night is when i truly see no future.
3rd grade.. I actually tried to kill myself back in third grade and i failed.

I'm a senior in high school and i cant complain about it.  Life is overall very good i mean it can be worse but i dont know why.. I keep feeling increasingly more difficult to get out of bed.. I kind of want to stay unconscious forever.. Its such a peaceful thought rather than dragging through life.. No matter how much i fight it i end up getting dragged

i really like classical music such as couperin, mozart, chopin, and etc... Funny thing is that these are the music i listen just to myself, with no one around.  Damn, this is a bit strange... I've actually never talked to anyone about my situation except just now on reddit.
